deploy-bot: Staging deploy initiated · env=staging · tag=release/v2.4.1-rc2 · commit=ab12cdef · triggered_by=alice · pipeline=hydra-staging · CI=https://ci.internal/redwood/1234

alice: Starting quick sanity and smoke suite now. Will watch logs and do a couple of prompt checks.

raj: Note: reranker had a recent runtime tweak in last PR. If we see memory spikes, consider excluding reranker from this rollout.

maria: We pinned model artifacts in test yesterday but runtime lib moved. @ops-oncall can you keep an eye on p95 and error %.

ops-oncall: Watching dashboards. Setting temporary alert thresholds: p95 +20% and error-rate >1% to escalate.

ci-bot: Changelog stub created for release/v2.4.1-rc2: inference kernel fixes + batching improvements. Please update with manual actions.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic 0% -> 25% complete. Health checks OK (passing 3/3).

alice: Observed brief 502 spike from reranker at +00:00:42, lasted ~18s. Logs show OOM on reranker pod on node-7.

raj: Confirmed. Stack points to new memory pool alloc in runtime. Suggest we pin reranker to release/v1.6 for this deploy to isolate.

maria: I agree. Keep reranker at v1.6, proceed with other services. That keeps staging useful for other QA.

ops-oncall: Scaled reranker pods +1 and restarted the affected container on node-7. No further 502s so far. Continuing to monitor.

alice: Continuing smoke prompts, posting results in ~2 mins.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished · env=staging · final_tag=release/v2.4.1-rc2 · status=SUCCESS (transient reranker OOM observed) · duration=00:01:14 · CI_result=https://ci.internal/redwood/1234/result

alice: Smoke largely green. Noted transient reranker OOMs; created follow-up ticket INF-479 to investigate memory alloc behavior and add heap dumps.

raj: I'll draft a hotfix plan: either revert runtime alloc change or increase pool sizing. Will coordinate a reranker-only canary pin to v1.6.

maria: For production we should block reranker runtime bump until INF-479 is resolved. Staging is OK for other validations.

ops-oncall: Alerts quiet after the restart/scale. Will keep 30m watch window and report any regressions.

ci-bot: Reminder: update release notes with the manual reranker pin (cherry-pick tag or manual entry).

alice: Adding note to release: 'reranker pinned to v1.6 in staging due to transient OOM; INF-479 opened.'

raj: Adding heap snapshot capture to INF-479 and tagging infra team.

maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Thread closed for this deploy. If further issues appear, mention @eng-oncall or reopen INF-479.
